confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese tourist-town pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and property. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value comes from a search-result summary of RBA statistics for 16 Oct 2026; the F11.1 table itself was not opened, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with smaller central and northern Vietnamese tourist towns such as Hoi An, Hue and Sapa-type destinations, priced somewhat below Hanoi's Old Quarter and Da Nang resort areas. Ninh Binh is a day-trip and overnight hub for Tam Coc and Trang An, so accommodation is priced for tourism demand while food and drink follow local norms.
